conflict_flags.rationale: SOW explicitly and repeatedly states $1,500,000 as the programmed construction budget. FAR 52.236-22 funding limitation clause states $3,000,000; this clause value on VA projects is commonly set at a multiple of the budget to allow for bid contingencies and potential redesign, not as a statement of the actual programmed amount. Both the SOW scope description and Moon Tree SF330 example projects reference $1.5M ECC, confirming the SOW figure.

The SF252 contract form (Block 6) is the governing contract document. The $11M figure in the Annual Reps and Certs section likely reflects an earlier SBA size standard table version. Minor discrepancy with no material impact on project record.
